faq_heading: Homes near Maple Green Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Maple Green Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Maple Green Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Maple Green Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Maple Green Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 38 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,305,000, townhomes $735,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Maple Green Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Maple Green Elementary the median was 36 days on the market, closing at 96.4% of the list price, with 11% of sales above the list price for the 38 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Maple Green Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Cornerstone Montessori School (0.4 km south-west), Janice Churchill Elementary (0.8 km south-west) and Enver Creek Secondary (0.8 km west).

Maple Green Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 14898 Spenser Dr. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Maple Green Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Maple Green Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Maple Green Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Maple Green Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 38 homes sold within 1 km of Maple Green Elementary: 31 houses and 7 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,305,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Maple Green Elementary

30 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Maple Green Elementary in a straight line (18 elementary, 10 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is Cornerstone Montessori School, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Frost Road Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Enver Creek Secondary (0.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Simon Cunningham Elementary (2.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: Cornerstone Montessori School (0.4 km south-west), Janice Churchill Elementary (0.8 km south-west), Green Timbers Elementary (1.2 km north-west), Brookside Elementary (1.3 km west), Coyote Creek Elementary (1.6 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Cornerstone Montessori School, 0.4 km south-west of Maple Green Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Maple Green Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Maple Green Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Maple Green Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Maple Green Elementary was $1,305,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Cornerstone Montessori School, the nearest other elementary school, 0.4 km south-west of Maple Green Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
